sources.entry: Courier MTA - Fast, scalable, enterprise mail/groupware server providing ESMTP, IMAP, POP3, webmail, mailing list, basic web-based calendaring and scheduling services. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 C/deb

summary.name: Courier Mail Server
summary.one_liner: Courier is an integrated open-source mail transfer agent and groupware server providing ESMTP, IMAP, POP3, webmail, a mailing list manager and basic web calendaring in one framework.
use_cases: Running a self-hosted mail server for multiple domains
Acting as an intermediate SMTP mail relay between LAN and internet
Providing IMAP, POP3 and webmail access to maildir mailboxes
Managing mailing lists with automatic bounce processing
Distributing mailboxes across several servers behind an IMAP/POP3 proxy
Using IMAP or webmail with other mail servers that store maildirs
summary.what_it_does: Courier is an MTA that bundles ESMTP, IMAP, POP3, webmail, and mailing list services under one framework, and individual components can be enabled or disabled. It uses maildir as its native mail storage and offers limited legacy mbox support through procmail or maildrop. Configuration uses plain text files and Perl scripts, with a web-based administration module for most settings. Virtual accounts can be authenticated via LDAP, MySQL, or PostgreSQL, and regular OS accounts via PAM. The IMAP server, webmail server, and mail filter can also be built as standalone packages for use with other mail servers that use maildirs.
notable: Integrated IMAP/POP3 aggregator proxy to spread mailboxes across multiple servers
Closed relay by default with SPF, DNS blacklists, and integrated mail filtering
Components such as the IMAP server, webmail, and mail filter available as standalone packages
Experimental fax gateway that forwards email to fax machines
caveats: Integrated POP3, IMAP and webmail servers support maildir mailboxes only; mbox requires other servers
ETRN is not and will never be implemented
Does not support dot-locking or AFS; rejects 8-bit raw headers and malformed MIME mail
Some features are experimental (IPv6, fax gateway, TLS private-CA enhancements) and calendaring is basic
